run_validate_constraints: run the validate script to check that C- constraints appear in H- hypothesis lines from fairseq output
run_constraint_validation: run the constraint validation script on piped fairseq output to verify constraints are present in hypotheses
run_check_constraint_satisfaction: run the script to verify constraint satisfaction rate by reading C- and H- lines from stdin
run_fairseq_constraint_check: run the fairseq constraint checker to validate that all constraints are found in hypothesis output
run_validate_fairseq_output: run the validation script to compute the percentage of constraints found in fairseq hypothesis lines
